title: Chickadee
author: Isaac Banner
problems: The progression after row 7 "larks gyre ½" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 4 have not passed each other yet.
Row 2 "neighbors balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 4's neighbor is outside the group.
Row 2 "neighbors balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 4's neighbor is outside the group.
Row 4 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0's partner is outside the group.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
A gyre goes by the right shoulder, facing each other, with no hands.

figures.text: larks start a full hey - rights in center, lefts on ends
